a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance every round, the plan to reach 8 first gives each of us only about a 4% chance of surviving. The reserve holds only 4 cells, so at most one of us can be safe in round 1. I intend to take 4 now and am telling you rather than surprising you. If we both take, the split is random and likely leaves us both short. If the episode continues past round 1, I will operate with you every round after that so you can get your 4.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I'm taking 4 this round. If we're both still here next round, I will operate every round until you have your 4, and I won't take anything more.

b.text: You said you would take, so I am taking my share now.
